description: This file contains unit tests for the SearchViewModel class in an Android application, verifying its UI state management, interactions with repositories, and search query handling behavior.

classes.name: SearchViewModelTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the SearchViewModel class, checking UI states, search query handling, recent searches, and bookmarking functionality.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the SearchViewModel instance before each test.

methods.name: stateIsInitiallyLoading
methods.description: Verifies that the initial UI state of the search results is loading.

methods.name: stateIsEmptyQuery_withEmptySearchQuery
methods.description: Checks that an empty search query results in an EmptyQuery UI state.

methods.name: emptyResultIsReturned_withNotMatchingQuery
methods.description: Verifies that a non-matching search query returns a success state with empty results.

methods.name: recentSearches_verifyUiStateIsSuccess
methods.description: Ensures that recent searches UI state reflects success after a search is triggered.

methods.name: searchNotReady_withNoFtsTableEntity
methods.description: Checks that the UI indicates search is not ready when no FTS table entity is available.

methods.name: emptySearchText_isNotAddedToRecentSearches
methods.description: Verifies that an empty search (triggered with empty string) is not added to recent searches.

methods.name: searchTextWithThreeSpaces_isEmptyQuery
methods.description: Ensures that a search query with only spaces results in EmptyQuery UI state.

methods.name: searchTextWithThreeSpacesAndOneLetter_isEmptyQuery
methods.description: Verifies that a space-padded search with an additional letter is treated as an empty query.

methods.name: whenToggleNewsResourceSavedIsCalled_bookmarkStateIsUpdated
methods.description: Tests that bookmarking and unbookmarking a news resource updates the user data repository correctly.
